method: Complete reads of six pinned source/documentation blobs; verified Git blob and SHA256. Build scripts not executed; provenance declarations not independently matched to upstream sources.
findings: Library build generates config.h from explicit feature/version values and embeds Python/shell payloads using C23 embed when available or generated include fallback. Formatter objects explicitly depend on payloads, and library depends on config/generated payloads. This explains build dependencies, not runtime correctness.

BLAKE3 build selects handwritten SIMD assembly for x86_64, per-object ISA flags for 32-bit x86 C implementations, NEON for little-endian AArch64 and portable fallback otherwise. x86 runtime dispatch intent is documented, but dispatch implementation and target matrices remain unverified by this audit.

versions.txt declares BLAKE2 commit fb4b09b, BLAKE3 tag 1.8.5 and xxHash v0.8.3 as unmodified imports. These are pinned repository metadata assertions, not independently verified upstream equivalence.

SHA3 README documents incremental Init/Update/Finalize with internal-context output pointer, no allocation/free, SHA3-224 unsupported and Visual Studio target not tested. Described self-tests are documentation only and were not run here.

Timestamp formatter writes current wall-clock timestamp during INIT, not after successful traversal/hash completion. It has no later completion/abort check and ignores fprintf status. Therefore an updated stamp alone is not evidence of a successful complete scan.
Null formatter deliberately registers no callbacks; selecting it provides no report or correctness evidence.
limits: No compiler-target qualification or executed benchmark result.
Review remains incomplete: 122 of 289 tracked blobs; problem pHash/ASAN item untouched.
